  Scenario: AC21 Error answers of the provided operations (readiness AC12)
    Given a request to a provided operation has no valid credentials, names a treatment that does not exist or comes from a role without the right U
    When the operation is called
    Then the answer is 401 without valid credentials, 403 without the right U and 404 for a treatment not found, all within the error set of the operation

  Scenario: AC22 Replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key (readiness AC13)
    Given a write has been applied with an Idempotency-Key
    When the same write is replayed with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the first result is answered and no second change is made

  Scenario: AC23 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event (readiness AC14)
    Given an event has been consumed with its cloud event id
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then the inbox dedupes by cloud event id and no second effect is made

  Scenario: AC24 Activity retry and timeout (readiness AC15)
    Given an activity of TreatmentWorkflow fails or times out
    When the retry policy of section 12.5 runs
    Then the activity is retried with the interval and back-off named in section 12.5 and is not retried on a refused record
    Then the release is answered once
